assumptions: Jessie base-system dependencies (lsb-base, procps, perl, mime-support) are satisfiable from the Jessie base system per the pack closure convention.
APT sources on the target resolve the archived jessie-security index that carries the deb8u16 stanzas.
The apache2ctl control interface is available on the target as the Debian control entrypoint.

artifact_source.reason_summary: Index-derived artifact path for the deb8u16 revision; retrieved bytes match the S010 stanza SHA-256 and size exactly.

build_system.reason_summary: FixType C is not a source build; build_system applies only to FixType A, so no build system applies here.

command.reason_summary: apt-get update precedes install; exact-version pins cover apache2 and its version-pinned siblings from the S010 closure; configtest precedes graceful restart under apache2ctl semantics.
command.value: apt-get update && apt-get install -y apache2=2.4.10-10+deb8u16 apache2-bin=2.4.10-10+deb8u16 apache2-data=2.4.10-10+deb8u16 apache2-utils=2.4.10-10+deb8u16 && apache2ctl configtest && apache2ctl graceful

fix_type.reason_summary: Debian deb OS package carried in the distro archive indexes; OS-package remediation under the Kalama contract.

notes.reason_summary: Advisory lineage, supersession rationale, scope bounds, and verification limits for the selected revision.
notes.value: DLA-1900-1 addresses CVE-2019-10092 and incidental CVE-2019-10098 on jessie. Scanner-fixed deb8u15 is superseded (no stanza in the live jessie-security index; existence corroborated by snapshot) and deficient per DLA-1900-2 and Debian bug 941202 (incomplete fix for the primary CVE plus balancer-manager regression); deb8u16 reverts the change and carries the correct upstream patch, so it is the selected fix revision. The target preserves the jessie backport lineage and amd64 revision chronology from installed deb8u12 to deb8u16, with no major-version move to upstream 2.4.41 or to the stretch revision. KEV is checked-negative for both CVEs. The source-built bash PATH prefix and live mod_proxy and mod_rewrite state are out of scope for patch-001 with no live execution; post-change assurance is bounded to version, config-syntax, and service-state checks.

source_identifier.reason_summary: Filename field of the live jessie-security apache2 stanza at the selected revision.

strategy.reason_summary: Default pairing for FixType C; jessie backport upgrade at the regression-corrected revision, no major-version move.

target_version.reason_summary: Live jessie-security stanza version and DLA-1900-2 regression-corrected revision; supersedes deficient scanner-fixed deb8u15 while preserving jessie lineage and revision chronology.

validation_command.reason_summary: Config-syntax check via the Debian control interface; verifies syntax only and makes no exploit-blocked or fixed claim.

warnings: Debian 8 jessie is EOSL; the archived security index is the supported artifact source.
deb8u15 must not be used: incomplete fix for the primary CVE plus regression per DLA-1900-2.
No live-container execution was performed; module configuration state is unobservable in this phase.
